title: tool: only ask for CURLOPT_CERTINFO when the writeout format uses it
body:
The tool enabled CURLOPT_CERTINFO for any -w. Certinfo copies every chain certificate as text and fails the transfer with CURLE_OUT_OF_MEMORY when a field exceeds its limit, so a server with a few thousand SANs made "curl -w '%{http_code}'" exit 27 after the transfer had completed, while the same transfer without -w was fine.

Only request it when the format uses %{certs}, %{num_certs} or %{json}.

files.patch:
@@ -408,7 +408,13 @@ static CURLcode ssl_setopts(struct OperationConfig *config, CURL *curl)
     MY_SETOPT_STR(curl, CURLOPT_SSL_SIGNATURE_ALGORITHMS,
                   config->ssl_signature_algorithms);
 
-  if(config->writeout)
+  /* certinfo costs a copy of every chain cert as text and can fail a
+     transfer on a huge chain, only ask for it when the writeout
+     format uses it */
+  if(config->writeout &&
+     (strstr(config->writeout, "{certs}") ||
+      strstr(config->writeout, "{num_certs}") ||
+      strstr(config->writeout, "{json}")))
     my_setopt_long(curl, CURLOPT_CERTINFO, 1);
 
   MY_SETOPT_STR(curl, CURLOPT_SSLCERT, config->cert);
